constraints.rule: NEXUS33_oro is the immutable visual and functional source of truth. Production optimization must not redesign it.
This project may never read, write, deploy, move, or modify Cano Penal artifacts.
Writes are restricted to clientes/eric-ramirez/** and root registry metadata explicitly owned by the Clientes repository.
No Vercel deployment is permitted until the user explicitly starts the deployment phase.
390px is the primary mobile judgment surface; desktop 1366, 1440 and 1920 are separately composed QA surfaces.
All motion must preserve prefers-reduced-motion behavior and may not create layout shifts.
Do not invent cases, testimonials, awards, results, credentials, media appearances, or client claims.
Historias de Éxito remains noindex until Eric provides authorized source material.
Target Lighthouse/PageSpeed 99+ on primary production URL; local budgets fail closed on CLS, JS errors, broken assets and excessive LCP resource weight.
NOT_TESTED is never PASS. Production certification requires measured evidence after deployment.
